role: Via robustness and mask/drill margin examiner
ratedEntity: Whole integrated Source24d board routing, viewed through via robustness and fabrication-margin evidence
confidence: High for scoped geometry and global via/drill/mask distributions; moderate for the overall rating
strengths: Fresh fully poured source geometry preserves all four barrel faces, authenticates the changed Ground0 origins and signal ownership, and clears current foreign copper at each changed barrel and incident path.
The two command/GND annular gaps improve from 0.154204/0.156078 mm to 0.234864/0.217864 mm; global foreign-via minimum improves to 0.175 mm and nine pairs remain below the preferred 0.20 mm.

The DAC nominal bore-to-requested-mask gap improves from 0.015 to 0.065 mm; native paste/pad bore gap is 0.115 mm. The global bore-to-requested-mask minimum is 0.025 mm, with no values below 0.025 mm.
Changed ground pickup annuli have full 0.314157 mm² direct contact with the main inner1 plane, including the regenerated signal antipad geometry.

Command complete conservative length decreases to 18.149655 mm under 18.3 mm; the DAC complete tap and R33 paths retain their existing maxima. Global via drill minimum remains 0.500 mm with no drill violations.

remainingRefinements.finding: Nine foreign-net via pairs remain below the preferred 0.20 mm annular gap; the declared 0.15 mm minimum passes. The closest VOUT_ADC/UART_TX pair is 0.175 mm.

Nominal bore-to-requested-mask minimum is exactly 0.025 mm at authenticated R206.pin1; R211.pin1 has the same tied minimum. Actual mask registration and tent profile remain manufacturing qualifications.
The DAC output tap conservatively measures 7.182950 mm against 7.2 mm, leaving 0.017050 mm CAD ledger headroom; subsequent coordinate changes need a fresh complete-path measurement.

overallRatingRationale: The original near-limit command annuli and sole DAC mask bottleneck are resolved in actual emitted and repoured copper while retaining net ownership and complete-path bounds. Remaining tight via pairs and a nominal 0.025 mm mask margin keep the board short of an excellent fabrication-margin rating.
limitations: CAD geometry and nominal requested mask/native paste; no manufactured mask registration/tent height guarantee.
Whole paths use the existing conservative 1.76 mm complete-board allowance per ordinary transition, rather than measured per-layer physical depth.
Scoped electrical geometry pass does not substitute for whole-board connectivity, Gerber shorts or other-agent integrated reviews.
